metadata.description: zstack manager-led agent team plus Claude Code mods built from the user's own usage.

plugins.name: zstack
plugins.description: Manager-led agent team: one manager sizes work with Jev and coordinates up to 100 scouts, planners, workers, reviewers, testers, debuggers, operators, verifiers and scribes over a shared message bus.

plugins.name: evidence-check
plugins.description: Flags replies that claim tests pass, fixed or verified when no test, build, lint, curl or DB check ran that turn.

plugins.name: intent-gate
plugins.description: Classifies each prompt's intent with Jev (question, plan, review, execute, ops) and blocks file edits and git writes on question, plan and review turns.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Notices the same failure coming back (a Bash command failing the same way, or the same error pasted again) and tells Claude to stop patching and diagnose.

plugins.name: rules-injector
plugins.description: Puts your zstack standing rules (house, global, project) into every system prompt, so you stop repeating them. /rules lists, adds and forgets them.

plugins.name: secret-vault
plugins.description: Replaces secrets pasted into prompts with ⟨secret:N⟩ placeholders, puts the real values back only inside tool calls, and masks them again in tool output.

plugins.name: ship-state
plugins.description: One line above the prompt: branch, ahead/behind upstream, dirty counts and the last test result, so 'is it pushed?' answers itself.

plugins.name: tool-fold
plugins.description: Click a tool call's ▸ to expand its full command, file, diff or prompt (and full Bash output); click ▾ to collapse.

plugins.name: turn-done-alert
plugins.description: Toasts when a long turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you, and shows a 'working 3m · 14 tools' heartbeat during long turns.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Status line with context fill and rate-limit use: ctx 42% 84k/200k · 5h 63% · 7d 12%.

plugins.name: zstack-pane
plugins.description: /zstack-pane (or /zs) opens a live pane of the current zstack run: agents, tasks, recent blockers and questions, and a field to steer all agents.
